title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_taikatalvi_by_tove_jansson_laila_jarvinen_2icz6 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_taikatalvi_by_tove_jansson_laila_jarvinen_2icz6' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted device. Removal of the package does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
